integrity: A self-contained analytical threshold proof with explicit finite and infinite constructions and reproducible exact identities. A review of related prior work was carried out; independent audit was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Real coordinate Hilbert spaces, bounded self-adjoint generators, at most three spectral levels and strictly positive simple leading eigendirection; the four-level witness uses the published DN critical-exponent theorem; 2026 manuscripts could only be inspected via abstracts.
title: A three-spectral-value barrier for gaps in positivity times of self-adjoint semigroups
